scripts.dev: npm run build:libs && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @education/api" "npm run dev -w @education/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm run build -w @education/api && npm run build -w @education/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:toolchain
scripts.test:staging: node --test scripts/staging-handler.test.mjs scripts/staging-release.test.mjs scripts/staging-trigger.test.mjs scripts/staging-readiness.test.mjs scripts/staging-vercel.test.mjs scripts/staging-mail-env.test.mjs scripts/staging-ai-env.test.mjs scripts/staging-database-env.test.mjs scripts/staging-backup.test.mjs scripts/staging-alert.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run build:libs && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run arch && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run build-storybook
scripts.build:libs: npm run build -w @education/contracts && npm run build -w @education/problems
